text:
ashley: Heads-up — saw a small 502 spike around 11:20 UTC on prod-ingress for /v1/generate. Can someone point me to the best dashboard + sample traces? Need to decide if we should debounce the alert or dig into traces first.

ben: quick pointers — use the 'Ingress Errors by Route' panel on observability.grafana.redwood (dash shortlink: https://grafana.red/ingress-errors). Filter: route =~ "/v1/generate" and status >= 500.

maria: also check the prefix-cache timeout panel (Observability → Runtime → Prefix Cache) — we've seen 502s correlate with cache eviction bursts.

ashley: thanks. Is there a short query for logs I can paste into the Logs UI?

ben: try this in Logs: `service:gateway AND http.status_code:[500 TO 599] AND http.path:/v1/generate | sort @timestamp desc | limit 50` — grab a request_id from the top results.

jordan: when you have a request_id paste it here and I can grab a full trace+timeline. If it's a gateway timeout vs upstream 502 that changes next steps.

ashley: sample request id: req_2026-03-18-11-21-07-xyz123 — can you pull trace?

sre-bot: alert: ingress-502-rate-high triggered at 2026-03-18T11:20:30Z (rule: ingress-5xx-rate, window=1m, threshold=5/min) :rotating_light:

maria: quick suggestion on alert tuning — increase evaluation window to 5m and require sustained rate > 4/min, or add a group-by route so noisy single-route flaps don't page SRE. That buys time to look at traces without churn.

ben: I've pulled the trace for req_2026-03-18-11-21-07-xyz123: looks like immediate upstream 502 from model-proxy (latency 120ms) + a flurry of KV cache misses right before. Link: https://traces.redwood.local/trace/abcde12345 (you might need VPN).

ashley: got it, thanks. So probably backend 502 not gateway timeout. Will open a quick issue on runtime to look at model-proxy handling during cache miss storms.

devex-bot: FYI — saved dashboard view with filters (route=/v1/generate, last=30m) at https://grafana.red/snap/ingress-generate-30m for anyone else looking.

jordan: for next steps — if the trace shows repeated 502s from model-proxy we should: 1) add a temporary retry/fallback on the gateway for 502->use-low-cost-variant, 2) increase debounce to 5m for ingress-5xx-rate, 3) collect a 1h flamegraph for model-proxy during the window. I'll coordinate with runtime if you want me to open the ticket.

ashley: yes please open the runtime ticket and cc me. I'll hold off on escalating pager until we see if rate stays up after debounce change. :thumbsup:
